text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On my day off, while shopping at the mall—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh... S-So bright...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I spotted Sakura Chiyono O squinting in front of a formal clothing store.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Um... I just had some free time, so
I came to look at dresses for the Droit."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "I was just thinking I might buy something if I found anything good, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm actually here, everything looks
so sparkly and dazzling...!
I can't make up my mind at all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“If we keep going like this, though,
we'll never make up our minds, will we...?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Chiyonoo-san.
Um, could it be... you're here to buy a dress?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Ah, but... they're all so pretty, I just can't make up my mind...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help wondering if it's really okay for someone like me to wear this,
and felt kind of sorry for the dress...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! I get it, I get it, I totally get it!
I feel like nothing looks good on me either!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I kept picking it up, putting it back,
picking it up, putting it back again and again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having hit it off, the two decided to pick out
a dress together. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she reaches for the glamorous dresses,
she unfolds each one and shakes her head—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A gorgeous dress like this
is completely out of my league, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, when she picks up a modest dress—
she falls into a sullen silence with an indescribable look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that,
time kept ticking away...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~!
What do we do, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "A different store... Y-You're right! It's important to broaden our options!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If we try a different store, maybe, just maybe...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to head over to a store that also sold general goods.
...And once there, we saw...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence.
Are you all out shopping together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...?
You seem rather exhausted, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Because you're mindful of your limits, is it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Um, if you don't mind,
may I pick something out for you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, how about an empire silhouette
with a natural vibe like this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The color is a simple white—which means
you can pair it with bold, chunky accessories like this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Wah...! Waaah...!
Th-This is totally my type...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. For Chiyono O-san, this one. A design with some sheer fabric will definitely look great on you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A pink base to match the hair color...
Pair it with accessories like pearls, and you can bring out a lovely charm that isn't too childish.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It's so beautiful!
As expected of Ardan-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I know.
I know that both of you are noble Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how dazzling the dress,
she wears it with such elegance, making her presence shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Please hold your head high and wear it with pride.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I, um...!
Th-Th-Thank you so very much...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, they had to give up on buying it that day due to budget constraints, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"This dress is so cute.
Oh, this one might be lovely too!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu,
I wonder what kind of dress I should wear~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From then on, Sakura Chiyono O seemed to take
a much more positive attitude toward picking out dresses.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great...!
"Turf grass needs maintenance too!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Nature-san, let's go get some tea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaah. That was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whew~, I'm so glad I went all out and got the
mega-stacked parfait! I'm completely stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...If only I could be just as decisive
when it comes to choosing a dress, though."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yeah!
Maybe it's because it's something you wear, but I just can't help feeling hesitant.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I do catch myself thinking how nice that would be, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, totally get it! Am I just agreeing with everything
at this point!? But seriously, I totally get it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can't help thinking how nice it must be, you know?
I guess I just can't let go of my admiration...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! That's why I just couldn't
bring myself to settle on a plain dress!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Someday, I want to be an Umamusume who can wear sparkling dresses, too... or s-something like that!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha!
Ugh, I totally get it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two hit it off far better than expected.
Though buying a dress that day didn't pan out in the end—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I found a great shop!
It feels like it's packed full of everything I admire...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, are you serious?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, I'm still too scared to go alone... Would you mind coming with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them were frequently seen whispering
together around the academy after that.
